page_title: TOT 1-2 WOL | Tottenham Hotspur v Wolves 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+4' Ben Davies (Tottenham) latches on to a superb cross into the box and plants a header well wide of the right post.
90+3' Timo Werner (Tottenham) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matt Doherty (Wolves) replaces Pedro Neto.
90+1' Pedro Neto (Wolves) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles past the left post.

90+1' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Jose Sa keeps the ball out.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
89' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde passes to Pedro Neto (Wolves), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar.
88' Boubacar Traore (Wolves) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Hee-Chan Hwang.
86' The attendance for today's match is 61532.
85' Ange Postecoglou has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham) replacing James Maddison.
85' It's time for a substitution. Giovani Lo Celso (Tottenham) comes on in place of Emerson Royal.
85' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner.
84' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Now Tottenham have a corner.
84' The foul by Pedro Neto (Wolves) was seen by Anthony Taylor who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
83' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Jose Sa makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom left corner.

81' Mario Lemina (Wolves) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom left corner is blocked by Guglielmo Vicario, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
80' Pedro Neto (Wolves) prepares to take a corner kick.
80' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Wolves force their opponents to concede a corner.
79' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
78' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
77' James Maddison (Tottenham) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

77' Emerson Royal (Tottenham) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Tottenham have been awarded a corner kick.
75' Pedro Neto (Wolves) takes a direct free kick.
75' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Wolves have a free kick.
74' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) hacks down one of his opponents.
73' Substitution. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pablo Sarabia walks off.
71' Substitution. Timo Werner (Tottenham) on for Yves Bissouma.
71' It will be a substitution. Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is ready to enter the pitch as Richarlison walks off.
71' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham) replaces Pape Matar Sarr.
70' James Maddison (Tottenham) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
68' James Maddison (Tottenham) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
66' Joao Gomes (Wolves) sees a yellow card from Anthony Taylor after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

63' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Joao Gomes (Wolves) fires a brilliant volley into the middle of the net from the edge of the box, leaving the goalkeeper helpless. Pedro Neto provided the assist. What a finish! 1:2.
63' The ball goes behind for a corner. Tottenham will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

63' A pass lands at the feet of Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
62' Ben Davies (Tottenham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
61' Tottenham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

60' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time strike from just outside the penalty area. The ball was aimed towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
57' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

57' Guglielmo Vicario was forced into action to thwart Pablo Sarabia (Wolves). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
54' James Maddison (Tottenham) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
53' Toti (Wolves) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Tottenham earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
52' Ben Davies (Tottenham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jose Sa, who smothers the ball.
50' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle after Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
49' James Maddison sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Richarlison (Tottenham), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
49' James Maddison (Tottenham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
49' Ben Davies (Tottenham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. Tottenham will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
46' 1 - 1 It’s a GOAL! It looked impossible to score from that angle, but Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) somehow finds the net with a cheeky shot past the keeper from close in.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+4' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
45+3' James Maddison (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45+2' Flag up against Pablo Sarabia (Wolves). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
42' 0 - 1 Joao Gomes (Wolves) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the top left corner. The score is 0:1.
42' Wolves win a corner.
42' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Wolves.
36' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
35' Ben Davies (Tottenham) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Joao Gomes (Wolves) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
30' Richarlison (Tottenham) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
28' The referee awards a corner and James Maddison (Tottenham) goes over to take it.
27' A dangerous looking corner kick from James Maddison (Tottenham) is cleared to safety by the defence.
26' A free kick into the box, taken by James Maddison (Tottenham), is comfortably cleared by the opposition's defence.
26' Toti (Wolves) commits a rough challenge and Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul. Tottenham get a free kick.
21' Mario Lemina (Wolves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
17' Mario Lemina (Wolves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
17' Richarlison (Tottenham) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Anthony Taylor no option but to blow his whistle.

15' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Guglielmo Vicario makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the bottom right corner.
14' Ben Davies (Tottenham) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
12' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!

6' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Guglielmo Vicario anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
5' Craig Dawson (Wolves) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
4' Craig Dawson (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
4' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jose Sa intercepts the ball.
2' James Maddison (Tottenham) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
1' Richarlison (Tottenham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. The ball goes out of play. Tottenham are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Tottenham will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor will referee today's match.
